identificationModule.briefTitle: Neoadjuvant Fluzoparib in Germline BRCA-mutated Three-negative Breast Cancer Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Neoadjuvant Fluzoparib Combined With Chemotherapy in Germline BRCA-mutated Three-negative Breast Cancer Breast Cancer: an Open, Multicenter, Cohort Trial

leadSponsor.name: The First Affiliated Hospital with Nanjing Medical University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Although many PARP inhibitors did not improve pCR in neoadjuvant studies, it is not an unchallenged conclusion that TNBC does not benefit from use of PARP inhibitors in neoadjuvant therapy.This study is an open-label, two-cohort, multicenter trial. 60 patients with germline BRCA-mutated three-negative early breast cancer are planned to be enrolled and treated with fluzoparib combined with chemotherapy according to tumor response after EC (epirubicin and cyclophosphamide) for 2 cycles.

keywords: three-negative Breast Cancer with germline BRCA-mutated

armGroups.label: Cohort1: Epirubicin+Cyclophosphamide
armGroups.description: 2 cycles of EC (Epirubicin+Cyclophosphamide) induced chemotherapy, if tumor response is CR or PR: Epirubicin+Cyclophosphamide for 2 cycles Fluzoparib+Paclitaxel for 2 cycles

armGroups.label: Cohort2: Fluzoparib+Paclitaxel
armGroups.description: 2 cycles of EC (Epirubicin+Cyclophosphamide) induced chemotherapy, if tumor response is SD: Fluzoparib+Paclitaxel for 4 cycles

interventions.name: Fluzoparib+Paclitaxel
interventions.description: Fluzoparib+Paclitaxel for 4 cycles if tumor response is SD after 2 cycles of EC induced chemotherapy

primaryOutcomes.description: pCR is defined as the absence of invasive residual disease in the breast and in the axillary lymph nodes (ypT0/is ypN0).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Event-free Survival (EFS) as assessed by Investigator
secondaryOutcomes.description: EFS is defined as the time from enrollment to disease progression or death due to any cause
adverse events and serious adverse events
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to the surgery (approximately 6 months)

locations.facility: JiangSu Province Hospital/ The First Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University
